description: This Java class 'UpdatesViewBinder' manages the UI components and interactions for displaying and updating a list of software updates within an Android app, including handling empty states, refresh actions, and observing update status.

classes.name: UpdatesViewBinder
classes.description: A class that binds UI components for displaying updates, manages refresh actions, and observes update status in an Android application.

methods.name: UpdatesViewBinder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes UI components, sets up RecyclerView, swipe-to-refresh, and observes update status.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Activates the adapter to start listening for data updates.

methods.name: unbind
methods.description: Stops the adapter from listening for data updates.

methods.name: updateEmptyState
methods.description: Updates UI visibility based on whether the adapter has items and manages observing update status.

methods.name: setUpEmptyUpdatingProgress
methods.description: Shows or hides the progress indicator based on whether updates are in progress.
